candidate.answerReason: The garden is 30 by 40 feet, so its 1200 square feet yield 600 pounds at half a pound per square foot.

methods.label: Convert the side lengths and apply the yield
methods.explanation:
First express both side lengths in feet, because the yield is given per square foot. The garden measures \(15\cdot2=30\) feet by \(20\cdot2=40\) feet. Its rectangular area is
\[
30\cdot40=1200\text{ square feet}.
\]
Each square foot produces an expected half pound, so the expected harvest is
\[
1200\cdot\frac12=\boxed{600\text{ pounds}},
\]
choice \(\text{A}\).
